title: Rose Pedals Chant
style: Electro-pop chant at a brisk midtempo with bouncy claps, rubbery synth bass, and a syncopated hand-percussion groove; verse rides sparse plucks and snapped vocal rhythm, pre-chorus strips to handclaps and rising stabs, chorus hits with stacked gang vocals and a chantable synth lead. Lead vocal is close-mic and playful with doubled hook words, ad-lib pings in the gaps, and a few call-and-response tags. Ear candy includes a filtered riser into each chorus, tiny reversed blooms between phrases, and a brief glitch stop before the final hook. Bright, glossy, and punchy with a candy-colored mix.

DJ Zyn

3. 3. 6.

aye i eye
Zyn Thee-o
Zynthio!

Raffa Raps
Micha Sings

One hand high

Steps too clean to beat

Say it slow
Then let it fly
Roll that name

Let it ring

[Chorus]

Rose Pedals
